One of OpenAI's unformalized Oct 6 preprints claimed an L3L^3L3 bound for the trilinear Hilbert transform. This had previously been a well-known open problem in harmonic analysis, and I think it's fair to say it was not expected to be solved any time soon. So far, (afaik) no human has formed a full understanding of the 93 page preprint.
But at least the result is now formally verified: here
I thought that everything that ended up on Palomar had to have a Formalization.yaml file but I couldn't find one in this project. How much did the formalisation cost?
